core_reading.name: Mental Training: Reading
core_reading.description: Read {target} pages of a useful book.

pool_deepwork.name: Deep Work
pool_deepwork.description: Work focused for {target} min without breaks.

pool_pomodoro_adv.name: Hunter Technique: Temporal Mastery
pool_pomodoro_adv.description: Complete {target} Pomodoro cycles today. Concentration is a weapon.

boss_pomodoro_marathon.name: Pomodoro Marathon: Eternal Flow (A-Rank)
boss_pomodoro_marathon.description: Complete {target} Pomodoro cycles in a single day. Time bends for those who master focus.

boss_focus.name: The Time King (S-Rank)
boss_focus.description: Strict Focus Mode for {target} hours, without failure.

boss_gps.name: Ice Wolf Lycaon (A-Rank)
boss_gps.description: Run a half-marathon or long distance: {target} km.

normal_boss_viper.name: Viper's Venom
normal_boss_viper.description: Run 5km or cycle 15km non-stop. The serpent awaits at the end.

normal_boss_crimson_knight.name: The Crimson Knight's Vow
normal_boss_crimson_knight.description: 90 min of absolute focus. The Crimson Knight watches. No distractions.

normal_boss_cerberus.name: Cerberus's Roar
normal_boss_cerberus.description: 100 push-ups + 100 squats + 30 burpees. Pay with sweat.

alpha_wolf.name: Alpha Thunder Wolf
alpha_wolf.description: Cover {target} km at an accelerated pace. The pack leader is watching.

sea_king.name: King of the Deep Tides
sea_king.description: 70 min of deep focus. Feel the pressure of the abyss.

dungeon_queen.name: Queen of the Forgotten Dungeon
dungeon_queen.description: 150 reps of strength exercise. Prove your resilience.

king_of_the_dead.name: Monarch of the Undead
king_of_the_dead.description: 120 min of absolute focus. The silence of the tomb is your ally.

boss_crypt_omega.name: Omega Crypt Spider (S-Rank)
boss_crypt_omega.description: Complex fight: {target} reps of an exercise of your choice every 10 mins for 1 hour.

boss_seraphim.name: Fallen Seraphim (S-Rank)
boss_seraphim.description: Purified mind: {target} min of continuous reading (fiction or philosophy).

boss_kargal.name: Kargal, the Mind Devourer (A-Rank)
boss_kargal.description: Eliminate noise: Stay away from screens/useless apps for {target} consecutive min before sleep.

boss_ignis.name: Ignis Ice Titan (S-Rank)
boss_ignis.description: Thermal contrast breaks limits. Run {target} km outdoors and finish with a 1 min cold shower.

boss_abyss_mage.name: Abyss Archmage (A-Rank)
boss_abyss_mage.description: Challenge the mind: solve 3 logic/math challenges in {target} min.

boss_blood_knight.name: Sangreal Blood Knight (S-Rank)
boss_blood_knight.description: Pure close combat. {target} repetitions of weightlifting (Deadlift/Squats).

boss_hollow_king.name: The Hollow King (S-Rank)
boss_hollow_king.description: Intermittent fasting: {target} min of total focus on work or study with Focus mode active, no snacking. Hydration only.

boss_cerberus_prime.name: Primordial Cerberus (A-Rank)
boss_cerberus_prime.description: Control the 3-headed beast by completing {target} km of morning running.

boss_wind_walker.name: Silent Wind Walker (A-Rank)
boss_wind_walker.description: Perform {target} min of continuous dynamic stretching (leg swings, shoulder rotations, hip circles) without pauses exceeding 30s. Focus Mode active.

boss_poison_monarch.name: Chimera Poison Monarch (S-Rank)
boss_poison_monarch.description: The poison is in the body. {target} burpees to sweat and burn the poison once and for all.

boss_goliath.name: Goliath of the Black Rocks (A-Rank)
boss_goliath.description: Heavy isometrics: {target} min of wall-sit or plank (accumulated time). Focus Mode active during effort.

boss_shadow_blade.name: Frightening Black Blade (A-Rank)
boss_shadow_blade.description: Shadow tactic: read {target} pages of strategy (without interruptions).

boss_iron_jaw.name: The Jaw Crusher (A-Rank)
boss_iron_jaw.description: Shadowboxing: {target} rounds of 2 min each, with 30–45s rest between rounds.

boss_astral_drake.name: Astral Dragon (S-Rank)
boss_astral_drake.description: Activate Focus mode for {target} min: perform Wim Hof breathing cycles (30 deep breaths + breath retention) and finish with 5 min of silent meditation.

boss_lich_king.name: Forgotten Lich King (S-Rank)
boss_lich_king.description: Resistant focus: {target} min sitting still, without distractions.

boss_tarantula.name: Imperial Tarantula (A-Rank)
boss_tarantula.description: Controlled march: cover {target} km on a predetermined route (avoid deviations), without music or phone.

boss_fallen_monk.name: Fallen Monk (A-Rank)
boss_fallen_monk.description: Stimulus fast: activate Focus mode for {target} min without accessing social media, videos or streaming — keep attention on a single productive task.

boss_swamp_wraith.name: Swamp Specter (A-Rank)
boss_swamp_wraith.description: Written self-analysis: activate Focus mode for {target} min and write freely about a current personal challenge — what is happening, why you haven't solved it yet, and one concrete thing you can do today.

boss_titan_ape.name: Titanic Primate (A-Rank)
boss_titan_ape.description: Total brute force: {target} alternating reps of push-ups + squats.

boss_astral_seer.name: Astral Oracle (A-Rank)
boss_astral_seer.description: Deep knowledge: read {target} pages of technical content without long pauses.

boss_astral_hound.name: Wandering Cosmic Hound (A-Rank)
boss_astral_hound.description: Endurance in open terrain: cover {target} km at a constant pace.

boss_archlich_prime.name: Primordial Archlich (S-Rank)
boss_archlich_prime.description: Project with deliverable: define a concrete result before starting (prototype, sketch, detailed plan or short article). Activate Focus mode for {target} min and finish with something tangible to show.

boss_soul_reaper.name: Soul Reaper (S-Rank)
boss_soul_reaper.description: Mental resilience: {target} min of creative work (light writing, drawing or project plan).

boss_astral_nebula.name: Nebula King (S-Rank)
boss_astral_nebula.description: Cosmic crossing: cover {target} km in a long, focused march.

boss_goblin_warlord.name: Goblin Warlord (A-Rank)
boss_goblin_warlord.description: Tabata: complete {target} rounds of 20s maximum effort + 10s rest. Define a single exercise before starting (burpees, jumps or sprints) and maintain maximum intensity in each round.

boss_cave_spider_matriarch.name: Cave Matriarch (A-Rank)
boss_cave_spider_matriarch.description: Feynman Technique: activate Focus mode for {target} min and explain in writing (or recorded out loud) a concept you are learning, as if teaching a beginner — without consulting sources during the explanation.

boss_ant_worker_prime.name: Primordial Worker (A-Rank)
boss_ant_worker_prime.description: Exploration route: cover {target} km on a path you have never taken before, choosing the way in the moment (no pre-defined route). Note 3 new things you discovered along the way.

boss_stone_golem_shard.name: Golem Fragment (A-Rank)
boss_stone_golem_shard.description: Try a new physical practice (yoga, capoeira, calisthenics, tai chi or one you've never tried): follow a tutorial and practice {target} min without interruption with Focus Mode active. Repeat the movements at the end without guidance.

boss_stringsinger.name: The String Singer (A-Rank)
boss_stringsinger.description: Guitar: {target} min of practice with metronome (3 chords + 1 basic rhythm).

boss_polyglot_trial.name: Polyglot Trial (A-Rank)
boss_polyglot_trial.description: Language: learn {target} words + write 5 sentences using them.

boss_culinary_ritual.name: Culinary Ritual (A-Rank)
boss_culinary_ritual.description: Cook: prepare 1 healthy meal + 1 side dish (from scratch).

boss_memory_labyrinth.name: Memory Labyrinth (A-Rank)
boss_memory_labyrinth.description: Memory: {target} min of focus to create a mental palace with 12 locations and review the associations 2 times in silence.

boss_new_frontier.name: New Frontier (A-Rank)
boss_new_frontier.description: Try something new: 1 short class (20–30 min) + 3 notes on what you learned.

boss_artisan_trial.name: Artisan Trial (A-Rank)
boss_artisan_trial.description: Build something small: 1 useful object (e.g.: stand, organizer, patch).

boss_storm_bringer.name: Storm Bringer (S-Rank)
boss_storm_bringer.description: Skill sprint: define a specific micro-skill you want to learn. Study it in Focus mode for {target} min and practice it immediately for an additional 15 min — without moving on to another topic before finishing.

boss_chrono_master.name: Time Master (S-Rank)
boss_chrono_master.description: Timeboxing: {target} min of focus (equivalent to 3 Pomodoro blocks of 25 min). Execute with 5-min breaks between blocks.

boss_star_breaker.name: Star Breaker (S-Rank)
boss_star_breaker.description: Documented exploration: cover {target} km on foot on a never-before-done route. During the march, identify and record (in writing or photo) at least 3 new elements you had never noticed.

boss_cold_philosopher.name: The Mountain Philosopher (A-Rank)
boss_cold_philosopher.description: Real problem analysis: define a concrete personal problem you are postponing. Research context and opposing opinions for {target} min (Focus Mode active) and finish with a written decision.

boss_digital_craftsman.name: The Digital Craftsman (A-Rank)
boss_digital_craftsman.description: Build something digital from scratch in {target} min: a simple web page, a useful script, a structured presentation or a prototype. The result must be functional or presentable at the end.

boss_stoic_challenge.name: The Stoic's Trial (A-Rank)
boss_stoic_challenge.description: Voluntary discomfort: {target} min of physical training in a real cold environment (outdoors in the cold, or open windows). Focus Mode active. Record how you felt before and after.
